Single Atomically Sharp Lateral Monolayer p-n Heterojunction Solar Cells with Extraordinarily High Power Conversion Efficiency

Yung-Chang Lin, Kai-Tak Lam, José Ramón Durán Retamal, Ming-Yang Li, Gengchiau Liang, Jr-Hau He, Lain-Jong Li, Lih-Juann Chen, Kazu Suenaga, Meng-Lin Tsai
The recent development of 2D monolayer lateral semiconductor has created new paradigm to develop p-n heterojunctions. Albeit, the growth methods of these heterostructures typically result in alloy structures at the interface, limiting the development for high-efficiency photovoltaic (PV) devices. Here, the PV properties of sequentially grown alloy-free 2D monolayer WSe2-MoS2 lateral p-n heterojunction are explores. The PV devices show an extraordinary power conversion efficiency of 2.56% under AM 1.5G illumination. The large surface active area enables the full exposure of the depletion region, leading to excellent omnidirectional light harvesting characteristic with only 5% reduction of efficiency at incident angles up to 75°. Modeling studies demonstrate the PV devices comply with typical principles, increasing the feasibility for further development. Furthermore, the appropriate electrode-spacing design can lead to environment-independent PV properties. These robust PV properties deriving from the atomically sharp lateral p-n interface can help develop the next-generation photovoltaics. By sequential growth of alloy-free 2D monolayer WSe2-MoS2 lateral p-n heterojunction, photovoltaic devices show extraordinary power conversion efficiencies of 2.56%. The large surface active area of the devices enables the full exposure of the depletion region, leading to excellent omnidirectional light harvesting characteristic. Modeling studies demonstrate the devices comply with typical principles. The appropriate electrode-spacing design leads to environment-independent properties.

row.text:
Yves TROUSSEAU, Président de l’ANDRH Groupe Orléanais, ainsi que l'ensemble du bureau, sont heureux de vous inviter au prochain événement de notre groupe en partenariat avec l’Association Nationales des Directeurs Financiers et de Contrôle de Gestion (D.F.C.G) qui se tiendra le jeudi 17 octobre 2019 à 19h00 au garden ice café, place de Loire à Orléans, sur le thème :

"Faire des évolutions réglementaires de la loi Pacte, des opportunités pour sa politique RH"

Dans un contexte où les dispositifs obligatoires et supplémentaires de retraite sont en pleine mutation (loi Pacte, réforme de retraite), l’épargne retraite devient un enjeu dans les politiques de rémunération globale des entreprises.

Entre solutions complexes et communication souvent trop orientée sur la gestion financière alors que les français ont très peu d’éducation sur le sujet, valoriser les dispositifs d’épargne-retraite en entreprise relève parfois de la mission impossible…
La loi Pacte est l’occasion de replacer les salariés au cœur du dispositif et de relancer leur intérêt.
L’équipe GO ! Epargne entreprise vous expliquera comment faire de ces régimes des outils RH efficaces et capteurs de talents tout en bénéficiant de gains budgétaires et sociaux au travers de 3 thèmes :
• La loi Pacte, un booster pour l’épargne-retraite et un axe d’optimisation budgétaire !
• Comment faire de la digitalisation un facteur clé de succès ?
• Le développement durable et local, des investissements plus vertueux et aussi générateur de valeurs/performances.

Au programme:
• Accueil : 18h45
• Début de la conférence : 19h00
• Cocktail : 20h30

Je m’inscris : https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc9CRWyEUSjYNa-dPPLARVoXk69Z9NHRxkPaXX61p07nWjpew/viewform?usp=sf_link

Vous n’êtes pas disponible, faites-vous représenter par un collègue.
Vous voulez inviter un collègue à venir avec vous, inscrivez-le en même temps que vous.
Au plaisir de vous recevoir nombreux lors de cet événement.
Attention : Vous êtes en retard ou avez un empêchement de dernière minute, merci de nous prévenir au 06.74.94.75.94 ou le 06.07.56.88.92.

 Lire la suite.

Україна активно працює над планом розвитку енергетики в рамках програми Ukraine Facility.
Секторальна робоча група з енергетики, яка займається підготовкою цього плану, обговорювала пропозиції від учасників. Ця група працює під керівництвом Міністерства економіки України за підтримки Київської школи економіки та має модерацію з боку KPMG Україна, повідомляє Урядовий портал.

Загалом, учасники групи внесли 32 пропозиції, що складають 45 політичних заходів для різних секторів енергетики. Ці пропозиції стосуються покращення законодавства у сфері енергетики та інвестиційного клімату, спрощення реалізації будівництва енергетичних об'єктів, зокрема ВДЕ, а також подальшої лібералізації енергетичного ринку.

Найбільша кількість пропозицій виявилась щодо розвитку відновлюваної енергетики (24), транспортування електроенергії (6) та загальної генерації (6). Згідно з результатами експертних обговорень, було виокремлено 32 політики, які рекомендовано для впровадження. Ці плани включають питання європейської інтеграції українського ринку, підготовки та вдосконалення законодавства для перспективних джерел енергії, спрощення дозвільної системи та лібералізацію ринку.

Під час роботи секторальної групи бізнесом та державними підприємствами було надано 190 пропозицій щодо інвестиційних проєктів загальною вартістю $58,4 млрд. Ці пропозиції стосуються різноманітних аспектів, таких як розвиток вітрової генерації, модернізація та розвиток електричних мереж, а також впровадження сонячної та водневої енергетики в Україні.

Bekam Panggilan Penggilingan Jakarta Timur 

Cari Jasa Bekam Panggilan Pengilingan Cakung Jakarta Timur ?? Call/SMS/ 087889491214 ( H.Slamet Irfan ) Jasa Panggilan Penggilingan, Cakung Jakarta Timur dan Sekitarnya.

Kami hadirkan layanan profesional terapi Panggilan Bekam ke tempat Anda di sekitar Penggilingan Cakung ,Jakarta Timur sebagai ikhtiar dalam mendapat keridhoan dan kesembuhan dari Allah SWT.

 

Insya Allah dengan pengobatan cara Nabi, selain mengamalkan sunnah, kita dapatkan juga kesembuhan (bi idznillah).

Bekam Panggilan Jakarta Timur

Rasulullah shallallahu ‘alayhi wa sallam bersabda :

الشِّفَاءُ فِيْ ثَلاَثَةٍ: شَرْبَةِ عَسَلٍ وَشَرْطَةِ مِحْجَمٍ وَكَيَّةِ نَارٍ وَإِنِّيْ أَنْهَى أُمَّتِيْ عَنْ الْكَيِّ

“Kesembuhan itu berada pada tiga hal, yaitu minum madu, sayatan pisau bekam dan sundutan dengan api (kay). Sesungguhnya aku melarang ummatku (berobat) dengan kay.”
(HR.Bukhari).

Ada Hari terbaik atau waktu tertentu untuk berbekam

Kami hadirkan layanan profesional berstandar Persatuan Bekam Indonesia terapi bekam panggilan ke tempat Anda di sekitar Pengilingan Cakung, Duren Sawit Jakarta Timur

sebagai ikhtiar dalam mendapat keridhoan dan kesembuhan dari Allah SWT.

Insya Allah dengan pengobatan cara Nabi dan di ajarkan bisa menjadi kebaikan , selain mengamalkan sunnah, kita dapatkan juga kesembuhan (bi idznillah).

Disney + nos enseña las nuevas imágenes de la serie de Loki

Mel Honey
-
mayo 19, 2021
0

Llega la serie de Loki, original de Marvel Studios, a Disney + y desde Marvel nos enseñan nuevas imágenes para promocionarlas.

Fecha del estreno

La serie de Loki estará disponible a partir del miércoles 9 de junio en la plataforma Disney +.

En el canal oficial Marvel España, en YouTube, han subido un vídeo con una serie de imágenes, llamado «Anuncio: Señorita Minutos», donde podemos contemplar nuevos detalles de la serie de Loki.

We request the pleasure of your company for Sushi Fusion’s 3rd Annual Honoree Luncheon on Sunday, March 22nd, 2020 at 1:00 pm at Thai Curry in Tamarac, Florida. Please respond by November 30th, 2019

For credit position: Looking for ULA for BSCI160, 202, 207, 222 - Fall 2019
From:
Francisca Saavedra <[log in to unmask]>

Daily eNews for CMNS Students <[log in to unmask]>

text/plain

text/plain (82 lines) 
Subject: For credit position: Looking for ULA for BSCI160, 202, 207, 222 -
Fall 2019
Description:
BSCI Undergraduate Learning Assistant (LA) Fall 2019
The Biological Sciences Program within the College of Computer, Mathematical
and Natural Sciences, will employ Learning Assistants (LAs) in the Fall of
2019 for BSCI160 (Dr. Shofner); BSCI202 (Dr. O’Brien); BSCI207 (Dr.
Carleton) and BSCI222 (Dr. Paczolt). The BSCI LA program is designed to
develop teaching, organizational and communication skills and provide a
leadership opportunity for undergraduates. THIS IS A NON-PAID position;
STUDENT WILL BE ABLE TO GAIN CREDITS FOR THEIR WORK. Each LA will be required
to perform the duties listed below.
LAs duties vary by course but in general an LA is expected to:
- Attend lectures.
- Adequately prepare for answering questions from students about the lecture
material
- Grade lecture assignments determined by faculty instructor
- Facilitate in-class activities
- Be available one week prior to the beginning of classes for LA meeting with
instructor
- Register in TLTC333 Academic Peer Mentoring (1 credit). This course will
provide the fundamental skills to support lecture activities (for new ULAs
only)
- Register for 1 credit course (BSCI279T, section TBD or TLTC399). This one
credit course is designed to give credit to Learning Assistants (LA) for time
spent with faculty helping inside and outside the classroom.
LAs must complete FERPA training during the first week of classes. This work
will require 5-7 hours per week, depending on the course requirements.  THIS
IS A FOR-CREDIT POSITION.  Do to time commitments for
this position undergraduate students may be enrolled for only one LA position
in any given semester.
Interested students fill out the application found here:
https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/ULA-F2019
LA APPLICATIONS ARE DUE April 15, 2019
Minimum application requirements:
-Second year student
-Overall GPA of 3.0 or higher (exceptions may be made on a case-by-case
basis)
-Have taken the course they wish to LA at UMCP and earned a grade of B or
higher.
-Students with AP credit for BSCI160 will have completed the next higher
level course with a grade of B or higher
-BSCI202 a LA will have earned a grade of B or higher in BSCI170 taken at
UMCP.
-Sufficient time free for the LA position
-Time free to attend lectures
-Meet for an hour a week to discuss course material
The courses available for LAs are:
BSCI160 Principles of Ecology and Evolution. Basic principles of biology with
special emphasis on ecology, evolution, and diversity.
Dr. Shofner: TuTh 9:30-10:45am
Dr. Shofner: TuTh 12:30-1:45pm
BSCI202 Human Anatomy and Physiology II. Anatomy and physiology of the
cardiovascular, respiratory, immune, digestive, urinary and reproductive
systems.
Dr. O’Brien: TuTh 8-9:15am
BSCI207 Principles of Biology III –Organismal Biology. The diversity,
structure and function of organisms as understood from the perspective of
their common physicochemical principles and unique evolutionary histories.
Dr. Carleton: MWF 2-2:50pm
Dr. Carleton: MWF 3-3:50pm
BSCI222 Principles of Genetics. Principles and mechanisms of heredity and
gene expression
Dr. Paczolt: MWF 1:00pm - 1:50pm, prep meeting Friday 9-10am
Contact Person: Francisca Saavedra
Contact Email: [log in to unmask]

Tel. 01434 674241

Open all year

Yvonne and Bob Routledge

Visit England Silver Award Winner

2014, 2015 and 2016

 

15% Discount available for stays in March 2017

To make a booking please call on above number or visit our online booking site

 

Welcome to Westfield Bed and Breakfast

A Non-Smoking Establishment

Situated in beautiful and historic Northumbrian countryside, close to Hadrian's Wall and Hexham, on the Stanegate Roman road, in the pretty village of Newbrough. With easy access to Hadrian's Wall, Langley Castle, Hexham, Corbridge, Carlisle, Newcastle, Gateshead and all of Northumbria's many attractions.

 

Relaxed atmosphere
Good food

At Westfield we like to think you'll enjoy a home from home experience.

In the centre of a pretty Northumbrian village, we have peace, privacy and all the amenities you'll require.

10 minutes west of Hexham, 5 minutes south of Hadrian's Wall, on the Stanegate.

Full Northumbrian or continental breakfast.In room tea and coffee making facilities.

Any request considered, to make your stay comfortable and personal.

Excellent pub grub at The Red Lion

(Tue - Sat)

En-suite Facilities

Comfortable, large en-suite rooms with lounge areas.

Ample off street parking.

 

Contact Us:

Tel. 01434 674241

Email. enquiries@westfieldbandb.co.uk

 

Follow @Westfieldbandb

www.westfieldbandb.co.uk

DODAJ OGŁOSZENIE, – warsztaty, kursy, szkolenia

lut 13, 2021 | Warsztaty Nauczycieli Vedic Art

Osoby, które chcą na stronie ogólnopolskiej Vedic Art publikować swoje oferty o warsztatach, organizowanych w różnych miejscach w Polsce i poza jej granicami, proszę, by przesyłały informację zawierającą opis, miejsce, termin i cenę w (pliku word) i zdjęcia (plikach jpg, png).

Na adres e-mail jacek.poteralski@gmail.com
Cena publikacji, każdego terminu warsztatu za okres do trzech miesięcy wynosi 30 zł.

Nie zamieszczamy wszystkich warsztatów, więc zastrzegamy sobie prawo odmowy ! zanim wpłacisz pieniądze poczekaj na e-mail zwrotny z potwierdzeniem o akceptacji przesłanych materiałów.

Match report | Preview
Republic of Ireland Under-21s will face a two-legged play-off for a place in the U21 European Championship after a 4-1 defeat to Italy ended their hopes of automatic qualification.


Ireland were beaten by the Azzuri at the Cino e Lillo Del Dunca in Ascoli on Tuesday evening.

A win would have seen Ireland reach their first ever major tournament at this level but they will now battle it out in the play-offs in September as goals from Nicolo Rovella, Nicolo Cambiaghi, Pietro Pellegri, and Giacomo Quagliata ensured it was the Italians that finished top of Group F despite Conor Coventrys second half penalty.

There wasnt much between the sides inside the opening quarter of an hour and despite having more possession, Italys best chance came from a corner but Caleb Okoli could only send his header over the target.

But the home side were given the perfect opportunity to take the lead in the 19th minute when Okoli was fouled by Mark McGuinness.

The referee pointed to the spot and Rovella curled his penalty into the bottom right corner.

The young Boys in Green reacted well to that setback as William Smallbone began to cause problems at the other end of the pitch but they would concede again with 35 minutes on the clock when Nicolo Cambiaghis low drive from 20 yards found the net via the inside of the left post.

McGuinness needed to produce a last-ditch block to deny Edoardo Boves thunderous goalbound effort shortly before Cambiaghis curler dropped just over the crossbar at the end of the first half.

It just wasnt to be Irelands day as Italy made it 3-0 moments after the restart as Cambiaghi pounced on a mix-up between Maher and McGuinness which allowed Pietro Pellegri to finish from a few yards out.

The Republic, to their credit, battled until the end and they grabbed what would ultimately prove to be a consolation just past the hour when captain Conor Coventry drilled his spot kick into the bottom left corner after Smallbone was fouled.

But Italy sealed a victory in the closing stages when, after good work from Samuele Ricci, substitute Giacomo Quagliata allowed the ball to roll across his body to take him away from his marker and slotted it past the keeper from close range.

Irelands attention now turns to the play-off draw which takes place in Nyon on Tuesday, June 21 at 12pm Irish time.

Republic of Ireland: Maher; OConnor, Cashin (OBrien 83), McGuinness, Bagan (Lyons ht); Smallbone, Coventry, Kilkenny (Odubeko 62), Wright; Kerrigan (Noss 62), Ferguson (Kayode 74).

1 Ottobre 2023 di webmaster

codice tributo 8911

Il codice tributo 8911 è una voce fondamentale da conoscere per chiunque si trovi ad occuparsi di questioni fiscali. Questo codice si riferisce specificamente ad una categoria di tributi che deve essere pagata in determinate circostanze.

Quando si parla di codice tributo 8911, è importante tenere a mente che ogni paese può avere una propria interpretazione e applicazione di questo codice. Pertanto, è essenziale consultare le normative fiscali specifiche del proprio paese per una corretta comprensione e applicazione del codice tributo 8911.

Per coloro che si trovano ad affrontare questo argomento, è utile conoscere le eccezioni e le situazioni in cui il codice tributo 8911 si applica. Gli esperti raccomandano inoltre di tenere un registro accurato e aggiornato delle entrate e delle uscite rilevanti per facilitare la dichiarazione fiscale e garantire la conformità alle normative.

È importante sottolineare che la corretta applicazione del codice tributo 8911 è fondamentale per evitare sanzioni e problemi legali. I contribuenti possono fare affidamento sui servizi di un commercialista o di un esperto fiscale per aiutare nel processo di adeguamento e per assicurare che tutto sia gestito in modo corretto e in conformità con le leggi fiscali stabilite.

Insomma, il codice tributo 8911 è una voce chiave da comprendere e applicare correttamente nel contesto fiscale. La sua importanza deriva dalla sua rilevanza nella determinazione dei tributi e nella conformità legale. Assicurarsi di avere una chiara comprensione di questo codice e delle sue implicazioni specifiche nel proprio paese è fondamentale per evitare complicazioni future nella dichiarazione fiscale e per garantire la corretta gestione dei tributi.

6 oktober 2005

KWC Eve; fascinerend spel van licht en water
Design keukenkraan met uittrekbare spoeldouche én lichtbron

Kranenfabrikant Hansa introduceert KWC Eve. Een keukenkraan die niet alleen in uiterlijk, maar ook in functie een aantal verrassende extra’s biedt. KWC Eve integreert de noodzakelijke water- en lichtfuncties in de keuken in één product. Intrigerend design voor een fascinerend en functioneel spel van licht en water. Bekroond met de Red Dot Design Award 2005.

KWC Eve herbergt in de draaibare uitloop een onzichtbaar verborgen spoel-douche. Het uiteinde van deze douche is voorzien van een transparante ring met LED-verlichting. Met een druk op de knop, die zich op de spoeldouche bevindt, wordt de lichtstraal geactiveerd. Zo worden de spoelbak en het werkblad functioneel verlicht. De lichtbron kan separaat geactiveerd worden, maar ook in combinatie met de waterstroom. Daarmee zorgt KWC Eve voor een fascinerend spel van licht en water, dat doet denken aan een intrigerende plasmastroom.

Slanke allure
Het design van KWC Eve kenmerkt zich door slanke allure. De hoge gebogen kraan heeft een ononderbroken, vloeiende belijning. Een storende verdikking aan het uiteinde van de uitloop - veelal onontkoombaar bij kranen met een spoel douche - ontbreekt. KWC Eve is vloeiend glad en slank tot in de kleinste details. Het ontbreken van de verdikking biedt niet alleen esthetische meerwaarde maar ook praktisch gemak. Rondom uitstulpingen en verdikkingen ontstaat namelijk gemakkelijk kalkaanslag. Dankzij de vormgeving zijn de kraan en de uittrekbare douche eenvoudig schoon te maken. Met één handbeweging wordt de spoel douche eenvoudig uitgenomen en teruggeplaatst.

Veilig
De designers van KWC Eve stonden voor de uitdaging de slank gebogen kraan te voorzien van een uittrekbare Neoperl-slang voor zowel de water- als de stroom toevoer bevat. De oplossing werd gevonden in een slang met twee lagen waardoor de water- en stroomtoevoer hermetisch van elkaar gescheiden zijn, voor een veilige werking. De slang is verbonden met een speciaal ontwikkeld aansluit element dat de toevoer van water en elektriciteit naar de verschillende technische componenten stuurt. De LED-verlichting in het uiteinde van de spoeldouche zorgt duurzaam voor een energiezuinige werking met een hoge lichtcapaciteit. De aansluiting op het elektriciteitsnet gebeurt via een laagspanningsadapter van 12 volt.

KWC Eve is verkrijgbaar in verchroomd messing of roestvrij staal. Beide varianten zijn beschikbaar met of zonder licht, vanaf € 403,50 (excl. BTW).

Meer informatie op website www.hansa-nederland.nl

Democracy Now!

An Invisible Crisis: African Migrants Stranded in Mexico Hoping to Head North

4 years ago Democracy Now
Share this:

“Hundreds of African migrants in Mexico are protesting the country’s refusal to grant them transit visas to travel to the United States or Canada, where they want to apply for asylum. For months, thousands of African migrants have been forced by the Mexican government to stay in the southern state of Chiapas, on the Guatemalan border. Many of them have been sleeping in tent cities, cooking on the streets and bathing their children in buckets, without the promise of shelter, food or work permits. The long waits for African migrants began in June when it was reported that Mexican immigration authorities were ignoring transit visa requests by African and Haitian migrants to legally cross through Mexico. For African migrants, the journey to Mexico often takes months as they cross the ocean to reach South America and then embark on a dangerous trek through the Colombian jungle and multiple Central American borders. We speak with Carolina Jiménez, Americas deputy director for research at Amnesty International in Mexico City.”

Democracy Now! is an independent global news hour that airs on nearly 1,400 TV and radio stations Monday through Friday. Watch their livestream 8-9AM ET: https://democracynow.org

Diventa un sostenitore!

Storie di Napoli è il più grande ed autorevole sito web di promozione della regione Campania. È gestito in totale autonomia da giovani professionisti del territorio: contribuisci anche tu alla crescita del progetto. Per te, con un piccolo contributo, ci saranno numerosissimi vantaggi: tessera di Storie Campane, libri e magazine gratis e inviti ad eventi esclusivi!

"Opening a World of Opportunities for People of All Abilities"

Blog

Camp K interviewed by KSOP – Cross Country – October 2015

i Nov 4th w Comments Off on Camp K interviewed by KSOP – Cross Country – October 2015 x by Camp Kostopulos

Listen to the interview by Dick Jacobson, of KSOP Radio below

Dick Jacobson, of KSOP Radio – Cross Country, interviewed Mircea Divricean, President and CEO of Camp K.
Mircea talked to Dick about the mission and vision of Camp K. For nearly 50 years, the mission of Camp K has stayed the same – to improve lives through education, recreation, and growth opportunities. However, over the years, Camp K’s programs and facilities have grown and expanded.

Mircea continued mentioning that during 2015, many prominent VIP guests, from all over the country, have visited Camp K. They have seen the unique, beautiful setting that is Camp K. Our community is fortunate to have Camp K in their back yard. Camp K is a charity – and our community is the stakeholders. We appreciate the generosity of this community, and how they have embraced Camp K throughout the years.

Mircea told Dick that he can’t praise Camp K’s staff enough for working, dedicating their time, and doing so much for those who need their support. The staff become role models. They work day in and day out to provide amazing opportunities for those people. When you go to Camp K, and want to experience something new as a staff member, it will probably be the hardest job you have ever done. However, it will be the most rewarding experience in your lifetime. Recently, we had one of our previous counselors return for a tour of Camp K. He told how his experiences changed his life – he is now the head coach at Southern Utah University.

Camp K has an exciting opportunity coming up in December – possibly the most exciting thing to happen to Camp K in 50 years.
Performing artist, Scott Helmer, visited Camp K for the first time in 2014. He was deeply touched by the impact that Camp K makes. On December 1, 2015, Scott Helmer and Camp K will break the Guinness World Records title for the most live concerts in 24 hours. The tour will begin in California, and will end in Salt Lake City. The purpose of the tour is to raise awareness for people with disabilities around the world.

For more information about Camp K, or the Guinness World Records attempt, please visit www.campk.org

Project Secret Weapon Phase II: Clean Water

In the summer of 2018, we traveled to Uganda for the commissioning of the Building Tomorrow Primary School of Mwiguru, located in the Masindi District that we helped launch in Phase 1 of Project Secret Weapon. We are so pleased that it is now up and running! While there, we clearly saw with our own eyes that clean water remains a huge challenge for so many in Uganda. In December 2018, the Ugandan Water Project – a longtime partner of Building Tomorrow – helped equip the Mwiguru school with a wonderful clean water solution.

Now, in 2019, we’re teaming up with the Ugandan Water Project to equip another Building Tomorrow school with two rainwater collection systems so students and teachers don’t have to make the long, daily walk for unclean water!

Help give children in Uganda their most important school supplies: clean water!

HART publication on aspirations in Further Education published

Posted on January 26, 2015 by Adam Evans — No Comments ↓

We are delighted to announce the publication of a paper relating to research carried out by the HART team in Sport, Education and Society. The work, led by Daniel Connolly and supervised by Dr. Jacquelyn Allen-Collinson and Dr. Adam Evans, focused upon Continue reading HART publication on aspirations in Further Education published→

HART Postgraduate Success!

Posted on September 10, 2014 by Adam Evans — No Comments ↓

This week saw two of the HART Postgraduate team successfully complete their degrees through Viva Voce examination. Both students were supervised by Dr. Adam Evans and Dr. Jacquelyn Allen-Collinson. Markets keep defying experts and the news

On Aug. 25, the S&P 500 index closed above 2,000 for the first time — finishing at 2,000.24. It had taken the index more than 16 years to double from its first close above 1,000 on Feb. 2, 1998, when it finished at 1,001.27. That 16-year span is more than five times as long as it took for the index to double from its first close above 500 on March 24, 1995, when it finished at 500.97.

On its way to 2,000, the S&P 500 had to endure two major bear markets. It fell from its high of 1,576.74 on Oct. 11, 2007, all the way to its low of 666.79 on March 6, 2009. That means the index has risen more than 1,330 points from its bottom five years ago.

From March 2009 through July 2014, the S&P 500 returned just over 22 percent per year, providing a total return of 195 percent — quite an impressive performance for the period. This year alone, it has defied many so-called experts and risen from 1,848 to 2,000, a price-only gain of more than 8 percent.

Israël - De IDF sprak over de gevechten in Gaza van de afgelopen 24 uur

Israël: De afgelopen 24 uur zijn de IDF-operaties geconcentreerd rond het Palestijnse vluchtelingenkamp Al-Shati in de noordelijke Gazastrook. Hier schakelden strijders van de Givati-brigade een groep terroristen uit die zich hadden opgesloten in een woongebouw, waar ze zich achter burgers verschuilden.

Nadat ze de terroristen hadden vernietigd, haalden Israëlische soldaten de bewoners uit het huis en hielpen hen via een veilige corridor naar het zuiden te evacueren. Op dat moment probeerden Hamas-militanten te schieten op de strijdkrachten die de veiligheid van de vluchtelingen waarborgden. De terroristen werden vernietigd door terugvuur van de tanks.

Bij een andere botsing identificeerden Israëlische soldaten een terroristengroep die aan het schieten was vanuit een huis naast het al-Shati-kamp. Ze werden vernietigd door een luchtaanval.

Tegelijkertijd viel de luchtmacht een munitiedepot aan dat zich in een van de gebouwen bevond. De aanval kwam nadat het voordetachement van de 215e Brigade de lancering van een antitankraket vanuit de structuur had geregistreerd.

PUT THIS ONE ON YOUR HOT LIST.
You don't saw what was happen ?
Thursday volume of ACEN has exceeded all records.
As you can see, investors finally valued the product and started to invest.
Pick ACEN
High $1.035
Last sale on $0.75.
Vol 561,673
AC Energy would like to provide further information on business strategies and encouraging market opportunities.
A new market study from Portio Research predicts that 50% of the world's population will use cellular phones by the end of 2009. The number of mobile subscribers worldwide reached over 2 billion by the end of 2005, and is estimated to rise to 3.96 billion by 2011. AC Energy's prospective primary customer base includes every existing and potential cell phone user in this swiftly expanding market.
AC Energy is currently seeking American battery and electronics manufacturers to act as licensees for our products. Our company has secured the necessary patent applications, and we are looking forward to continued growth and prosperity as we expand the licensing of our technology worldwide.
Also, I am sure Mike can handle the heat.
He is also apparently the unoffiicial or official RGP liaison.
Now my take on a customer explaining.
The only question is whether that testing occurs in a test environment or in the field.
I realize he doesn't write the software.
> Hey Mike,
If you can't handle one computer malfuntion, then you might want to think about the slight possibibilty of going into another means of  supporting your selfish self, if you catch my drift!
One more thing, this isn't the first, second, or even third major software problem has had at a big moment.

Contact us

App and web troubleshooting

If you're having trouble with the Spotify for Podcasters mobile app or the web version of Spotify for Podcasters, try these tips.

Mobile app issues

  • Close and restart the app
  • Reinstall the app to check you're on the latest version. You can find a guide to reinstalling below
  • Close any other apps you aren't using
  • Ensure you have a stable and active internet connection
  • Switch off your device’s WiFi connection, wait 30 seconds, then switch it back on
  • Connect to a different network, if possible
  • Restart your router, if possible
  • Restart your device
  • Update your device's operating system

Reinstalling the app

A clean reinstall of the Spotify for Podcasters mobile app often fixes common technical issues.

Spotify for Podcasters website issues

  • Make sure you're on the latest version of your browser by checking your browser settings
  • Open Spotify for Podcasters in a private or incognito window. You can typically do this from your browser's tabs or menu buttons (often represented by 3 dots or bars). Check your browser's help center for exact steps
  • Open Spotify for Podcasters in a different browser
  • Clear your browser's cache and cookies

About Us

Where ideas meet technology and turn into solutions

Generally, our company provides solutions based on internet technologies. Solutions for business, for entrepreneurs, for companies, for institutions, for startups, for active people ... for people.

Our goal is to provide solutions that solve a specific problem, and advise in scope of our specialties, as well as lend our experience, which is often more valuable than years of study.

"We're here because you need us" and as long as the world needs our support, we will be here.

 

Our mission

Provide high quality products and services that solve problems. Help in need - according to our capabilities. To meet problems. To face up the problems.

 

Our vision

We want to make a significant contribution to the development of humanity and encourage people to find good values in them and guide them in life.

 

About NTRFB

We work with enterprises, companies and institutions in the field of internet technologies. Using our many years of experience, we provide uncompromising products and services. At every step, we try to improve our culture and care for even the smallest aspect of communication with the client.

Задача A. Археологи и курганы ≡

  • задачи
Входной файл:Стандартный вход Ограничение времени:1 сек
Выходной файл:Стандартный выход Ограничение памяти:256 Мб
Максимальный балл:100 

Условие

При предварительном исследовании планеты Каппа-2 были обнаружены следы исчезнувшей цивилизации. Расшифровка найденных письменных источников указала на странный погребальный обряд. На прямоугольном поле, размеченном как таблица, строились курганы разной высоты. При этом могилы наиболее почитаемых граждан располагались следующим образом: в столбце такой курган имеет максимальную высоту, что показывает количество благостных деяний, в строке - минимальную, что говорит о малом количестве грехов.

При подготовке к раскопкам было решено начать с курганов тех граждан, которые имели максимальное количество благостных деяний и минимальное количество грехов. Для этого археологи просят Вас составить программу, определяющую курганы наиболее почитаемых граждан. Если таких курганов не найдено, то Вас просят вывести 0.

Формат входных данных

В первой строке подается число N – количество строк и столбцов поля с курганами.

Следующие N строк содержат по N целых чисел ai, – высоты курганов.

Формат выходных данных

Выведите k строк по 2 целых числа через пробел i, j, 1 ≤ i, j ≤ N – индексы строк и столбцов соответственно, на пересечении которых находятся курганы наиболее значимых граждан (порядок вывода курганов значения не имеет). Если таких курганов нет, то выведите 0.

Ограничения

1 ≤ N ≤ 1500

 − 109 ≤ ai ≤ 109

Recent Posts

Daftar Kelas Online Bekal Menikah Muslimah #1

Sebuah Program Spesial Untuk Muslimah Indonesia

Pembelajaran & Pendampingan Online selama 100 Hari +++

Yuk daftar Kelas Online Bekal Menikah Muslimah, sebuah program persiapan yang akan membantumu untuk menjadi seorang istri dan juga ibu. Dalam program pembelajaran dan pendampingan selama 100 hari lebih ini Kamu akan ditempa dan diberikan bekal-bekal untuk menghadapi kehidupan setelah pernikahan.

Ada 4 Kurikulum Pembelajaran yang akan Kamu dapatkan ketika mengikuti program pembelajaran dan pendampingan ini :

1. Menata dan Mendesain Kehidupan Pribadi Menjadi Lebih Baik 

Pada tahap awal pembelajaran Kamu akan diajak untuk melakukan perjalanan ke dalam dirimu, melihat mana yang buruk, dan mana yang bagus. Lalu Kamu akan didampingi berproses serta bertumbuh menjadi pribadi yang lebih baik. Pada tahapan ini Kamu akan belajar menemukan misi hidup, mengenali kebiasaan buruk serta mengubahnya, menjadikan waktumu menjadi lebih produktif dan berharga, mengatur keuangan pribadi secara cerdas dan banyak lagi yang lainnya.

2. Memahami Konsep Dasar Pernikahan Islami 

Setelah menata dan mendesain diri Kamu masuk ke pembelajaran selanjutnya yaitu memahami konsep – konsep dasar islam dari masa pranikah hingga pernikahan.

3. Membangun Relationship Dengan Pasangan

Ini mungkin pembelajaran yang Kamu tunggu dan cari-cari selama ini. Pada tahap pembelajaran ini Kamu akan belajar ilmu-ilmu dari yang paling sederhana hingga yang lebih rumit dalam membangun hubungan dengan suami.

4. Mempersiapkan diri menjadi seorang Ibu

Siap untuk menikah tentunya juga siap untuk menjadi ibu bukan ? Nah di pembelajaran ini Kamu akan mendapatkan materi-materi persiapan menjadi seorang ibu.

Itulah 4 kurikulum pembelajaran yang akan Kamu dapatkan selama pembelajaran ini. Selain belajar Kamu dalam program ini juga didampingi. Kami akan mendampingimu secara pribadi baik dalam konsultasi maupun diskusi.

Kontribusi Belajar

Untuk mengikuti pembelajaran ini Kamu cukup berkontribusi sebesar Rp.300.000,- saja. Yang itu artinya biaya belajarnya hanya Rp.3000,- per hari. Sangat murah dan mudah sekali bukan.

Metode Pembelajaran

Pembelajaran akan dilansungkan di grup whatsapp, melalui email dan juga whatsapp pribadi selama 100 hari lebih. Materi di grup whatsapp berupa kuliah whatsapp 2 kali seminggu.

山西建国提醒爬架的提升作用是什么？
云更新

山西建国爬架网沿修建物外侧搭设不大于5倍楼层高的外脚手架，通过附着支承附着在工程结构上，依托自身的升降设备完结升降的悬空脚手架，脚手架带有升降动力设备，具有的防倾覆、防掉落安装，跟着工程中止，脚手架沿修建物升降。附着式升降脚手架适用于外立面根本没有改变的高层修建物的结构施工和装饰施工。普通关于17层以上的修建物经济效果尤为明显，修建物越高经济效益越大，而且不受修建层高改变的影响。

沿修建物外侧搭设不大于5倍楼层高的外脚手架，通过附着支承附着在工程结构上，依托自身的升降设备完结升降的悬空脚手架，脚手架带有升降动力设备，具有的防倾覆、防掉落安装，跟着工程中止，脚手架沿修建物升降。附着式升降脚手架适用于外立面根本没有改变的高层修建物的结构施工和装饰施工。

普通关于17层以上的修建物经济效果尤为明显，修建物越高经济效益越大，而且不受修建层高改变的影响。

运用者应当对产品的自身粘结材料中止一个恰当的清算，如若有必要时，也要对产品的牵引机制中止调整，以改进情况的一起，不会稠浊入再次发生的情况。一起运用者还要定时中止电路的检修，以免产品在应用的进程中会出现毛病，对结构构成一定的影响。

山西建国全钢爬架网又称附着式升降脚手架、建筑外墙防护爬架，目前有许多建筑工地都能看到全钢爬架网等产品，而近年来，像爬架网这样的产品制造商也不少。

一、如何区分全钢爬架网片的种类

爬架网是本世纪初发展起来的新型脚手架技术，对我国施工技术的进步有着重要的影响，爬架网从高处工作变为低处工作，从悬空工作变为内部工作。其中，全钢爬架网片按能源分类，分为液压式、电动式、人力拉伸式等3种。不同的种类有不同的作用，我们应该根据实际情况选择合适的设备，保障人们的安全。

二、全钢爬架网片在建筑施工中的使用

全钢爬架网适合用在高层建筑的施工和装饰上使用，通常在15层以上的建筑物的经济效益会比较的显著。并且建筑物的楼层越高，经济效益就会越大，而全钢爬架网也不会因为建筑物的高度变化而受到影响。由于土地资源短缺，城市高层建筑越来越多，同时施工现场没有多余的管道和紧固件，因此有利于爬行网施工现场的建设。

将框架与建筑物的固定支点松开，将螺栓与连接建筑物的斜杆松开，观察框架的稳定性，并检查全钢爬架网络与建筑物的正常碰撞或接触。这时，爬架网仅与电动葫芦、导向杆、导向轮和升降梁连接或接触，以锌金属板为原料，与周边焊接框架固定。爬架结构的质量和焊接工艺将直接影响爬架安装过程的稳定性，同时也将直接影响施工人员的人身安全。所以建筑保护爬架焊接框架的生产显得尤为重要。
